mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, such that the market interprets low rates as a positive signal for equity performance, producing consistent positive returns regardless of rate level.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d returns is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals improving labor market conditions, which are associated with higher equity returns over the next 5 trading days due to stronger consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of 5-day windows where UNRATE < 4.0%, S&P 500 returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 275 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 0.5%, the market interprets this as persistent inflation without monetary tightening, leading to negative equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of 60-day windows where CPIAUCSL > 275 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, S&P 500 returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% and maintaining that level for three months signals a monetary tightening cycle, which is associated with negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of 20-day windows where FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and rising for 3 months, S&P 500 returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 thousand units signal strong demand for residential construction, which is associated with positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days due to improved consumer confidence and economic growth.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of 20-day windows where HOUST > 1500, S&P 500 returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 indicates a slowdown in manufacturing activity, which is associated with negative equity returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced economic output and weaker corporate earnings.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of 5-day windows where INDPRO < 95, S&P 500 returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: When residential sales (RSAFS) exceed 600,000 million dollars and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1500 thousand units, the market interprets this as a strong housing market, which is associated with positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days due to sustained consumer spending and economic expansion.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of 60-day windows where RSAFS > 600000 and HOUST > 1500, S&P 500 returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: Gross domestic product (GDPC1) above 20,000 billion dollars (2017 chained dollars) signals robust economic growth, which is associated with negative equity returns over the next 60 trading days due to potential overvaluation and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of 60-day windows where GDPC1 > 20000, S&P 500 returns are positive.
